testResults.name: hosted-runtime-composition
testResults.result: 10 focused tests passed: hosted_overrides is empty without LAKE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME, the runtime builds Azure Table catalog and job repositories plus the SAS issuer from environment configuration, create_app consumes the hosted overrides, equity ensure plans only closed XNYS sessions with canonical symbols, missing provider credentials raise HostedEnsureError, non-equity ensure is rejected, and the job launcher marks durable jobs succeeded while propagating failures for ensure_coverage failure marking

testResults.name: cli-local-and-http-regression
testResults.command: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest tests/lake/cli tests/lake/local tests/lake/http -q
testResults.result: 102 tests passed including the CLI ingest tests after the BoundedAlpacaClient move, the local-mode tests that forbid Azure authentication in workstation mode, and the HTTP application and route suites

testResults.name: repository-wide-quality-gates
testResults.result: Repository-wide Ruff lint, format check, and ty type check passed, and the complete pytest suite passed with 845 tests

limitations: The hosted runtime composes Azure SDK clients lazily and construction performs no network access; live behavior is exercised by the T048 dev smoke against the deployed Container App
Crypto and option ensure requests are intentionally rejected with HostedEnsureError until their dedicated runtime tasks land
